key_idea: Put the trains in order from shortest to longest.
steps: The blue train is longer than the red train: red, blue.
The blue train is shorter than the yellow train: red, blue, yellow.
The green train is shorter than the red train: green, red, blue, yellow.
The yellow train is at the end of the line, so it is the longest.

choice_feedback.A: The yellow train is longer than the blue train.
choice_feedback.B: The blue train is longer than the red train.
choice_feedback.D: The green train is the shortest of all.
choice_feedback.E: The clues put all 4 trains in order, so we can decide.
